name: std/list
description: Declares growable lists of borrowed byte pointers.
readme: Declares growable lists of borrowed byte pointers.
Import this module with use list.

files.content:
-- Declares growable lists of borrowed byte pointers.
public define List as opaque.
public use "list" function create() of type fallible pointer to List.
public use "list" function push(collection of type pointer to List, item of type pointer to byte) of type fallible nothing.
public use "list" function get(collection of type pointer to List, index of type unsigned 64) of type fallible pointer to byte.
public use "list" function length(collection of type pointer to List) of type fallible unsigned 64.
public use "list" function close(collection of type pointer to List) of type fallible nothing.
